newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end steady to up, light ends firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end steady to up, light ends firm.

text.p: NWE oil products ended steady to higher on Tuesday with prompt naphtha supply still tight.
Naphtha swaps rose and cash was steady at its strong Monday levels as traders bid up prompt cargoes.
High sulphur fuel oil barges steadied at around $98 fob ARA after recent volatility. A Shell trader said that technical problems at the Rotterdam refinery had been ironed out.
Gas oil gained up to $4 a tonne on stronger IPE futures. Barge premiums were a touch easier, but cargoes held steady.
Gasoline rose slightly on talk of refinery run cuts and a correction to Monday's sharp drop toward the $200 level.
